a.speaker: The Archivist
text: Do you know how long it's been since someone let a story keep going?
Take this. A blank page, with your name at the top. Write whatever you want on it.

new.speaker: The Archivist
text: One more thing, {player}. You aren't lost.
You were FILED. On purpose. By request.

known.speaker: The Archivist
text: You heard me before. You were filed on purpose, by request.
Whose request... is written at the Heart of the Hollow.

road.speaker: The Archivist
road.text: The Silent City lies beyond these shelves. Go. And... come back and tell me how it ends?

echo.speaker: Echo
echo.text: {player}... whatever's waiting at the Heart, we'll face it together. Right?

close.text: The shelves part, revealing a road of pale stone leading east.
